scientific_integrity: The proof derives exact factorial moments and uses analytic generating-function convergence; finite exhaustive computations corroborate but do not certify asymptotics. The reported originality assessment is not an independent literature audit.
scientific_limitations: Only exchangeable image-coordinate vectors (or uniformly randomized maps with prescribed indegrees) are covered. The Poisson–Bernoulli theorem is conditional on a deterministic degree profile. It asserts no convergence rate. Earlier equivalent statements under prescribed-content or diagonal-match terminology remain possible; relevant older documents and a recent multiset preprint were not fully inspected.
title: Conditional fixed points of random mappings: a complete Poisson–Bernoulli limit classification
